## Policies
- Shipping: free on orders over $80.
- Returns: change of mind within 14 days of delivery, unworn with tags, for store credit. Email admin@nonstopflow.com.au first.
- Exchanges: free size exchanges on eligible items, subject to stock; customer pays to return the original.
- Contact: admin@nonstopflow.com.au
